closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, adds hydrating volume, and easy salad base, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low magnesium, and low vitamin C. It is good for low-calorie volume and practical meals because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
